from common import *

save_source(__file__)
progress=read(PROGRESS)
assert progress['pipeline_stage']=='final_report_ready_for_native_lifecycle'
assert len(progress['jobs'])==20 and all(j['status']=='succeeded' for j in progress['jobs'])
assert all(v['status']=='completed' for v in progress['scientific_candidates'].values())
assert read(BASE/'docs/final-numerical-verification.json')['status']=='complete'
check(read(BASE/'docs/cache-reference.json'))
c=read(BASE/'docs/research-conclusion.json')
evidence=[BASE/'metrics'/f'{REPRESENTATIVE}-new.json']+[BASE/'docs'/n for n in ['final-numerical-verification.json','research-conclusion.json','final-report-receipt.json','review-final-numerical.json','early-stopping-replay.json']]
state=harness('check')
assert state['variants'][EID]['attempts'][-1]['outcome']=='running','Inspect existing lifecycle; do not duplicate terminal events.'
for event in [
 {'type':'result','exp_id':EID,'outcome':'succeeded','evaluation':str(evidence[0].relative_to(ROOT)),'evidence':[str(p.relative_to(ROOT)) for p in evidence]},
 {'type':'registered','exp_id':EID},
 {'type':'reported','exp_id':EID},
 {'type':'reflection','round':1,'observations':'；'.join(c['observations']),'interpretation':c['conclusion'],'new_evidence':True,'next_hypothesis':''},
 {'type':'stop','reason':'hypotheses_exhausted'}
]:
 s=harness('event',event);print(event['type'],s['status'],s['revision'],flush=True)
print('Scientific lifecycle stopped; exact temporary cleanup and native close remain.',flush=True)
